steps.action: Confirm the municipality and what the user wants to do (the procedure). Ask only for what is needed; do not collect personal data.
Find the municipality in the knowledge skill and list the ordinances that may apply, with their official URLs and retrieval dates.
Ask the user to open the official source, or, only if the user approves that exact request, fetch the official page; read the primary text before stating any rule.
Produce a checklist of what the user must confirm or prepare, each item tied to its source; mark anything not found in the primary text as unknown.
Point to the official channel for the procedure (site, office, contact from the organization record). State that the information is a snapshot and that the user files or applies personally.
